subject: Confirming May 19 demo — vendor portal + NDA prerequisites
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@medsys.co>, procurement@medsys.co
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming May 19 demo — vendor portal + NDA prerequisites

Hi Rajiv,

Looking forward to the technical demo we tentatively scheduled for Wed, May 19 at 10:00am PT. Before we run the full product walkthrough with your engineering and security teams, our standard intake shows a couple of prerequisites procurement asks for: a signed NDA on file and completion of your vendor portal questionnaire (they specifically need the SOC2 artifact and data classification answers).

Can you confirm:
- NDA: do you want to countersign (I attached our template) or do you already have a standing mutual NDA?
- Vendor portal: can you share the portal ticket or point us to the questionnaire so we know which fields are outstanding?

If the procurement gating will take longer than a few days, we can either: (A) run a high-level product overview for the PMs/engineers that avoids sensitive workflow examples, or (B) reschedule the hands-on demo until the portal is complete. Please advise which you'd prefer.

Attaching: nda-template-redwood.pdf (stub).

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@medsys.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medsys.co>, Sally Cho <sally.cho@medsys.co>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirming May 19 demo — vendor portal + NDA prerequisites

Monica —

Thanks for the heads up. We did receive the NDA and I uploaded a signed copy this morning (see attached nda-signed.pdf). That part is good.

Procurement flagged that their policy requires vendors to complete our portal questionnaire before any technical demo that includes PII or production-like examples. Our procurement lead, Sally (cc'd), says the portal still shows several unanswered questions around data retention, subprocessor lists, and SOC2 evidence. Our CISO will not attend a hands-on demo until the vendor portal is complete.

Given that, we'd prefer to push the hands-on demo — can you propose a few dates in early June? If your team can provide a short SOC2 summary and the specific questionnaire link, procurement can expedite the intake. Also we have a travel blackout week May 23-27 for on-site audits, so May 19 is tight for some stakeholders.

Thanks,
Rajiv
VP, Eng — Medsys Health

Attachment: nda-signed.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@medsys.co>, Sally Cho <sally.cho@medsys.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirming May 19 demo — vendor portal + NDA prerequisites

Hi Rajiv / Sally —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the NDA and the context on procurement. I've attached a one-page SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and below are the direct links we think will help procurement complete the questionnaire faster:
- Questionnaire fields we typically see flagged: data retention policy, encryption at rest/in transit, subprocessor list, incident notification timelines.
- DocuSign / signed NDA: https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/signed/abc123
- Example artifact we can share via secure file transfer if procurement needs full reports.

Proposal:
- Move the hands-on demo to the week of June 1 — suggested slots: Tue Jun 1 10:00am PT, Thu Jun 3 2:00pm PT, or Tue Jun 8 9:30am PT.
- In the meantime, Rafael from CS (cc) can run a 30-minute high-level product overview this Thursday May 13 at 11:00am PT that avoids production examples and should be safe for your PM/eng team while procurement completes the portal.

Jordan — can you please open the vendor intake ticket on our side and include the SOC2 summary and the list of answers procurement usually wants? If you can get portal access details back to Sally by EOD tomorrow, that should keep this moving.

Monica

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirming May 19 demo — vendor portal + NDA prerequisites

Monica / Rafael —

Opening vendor intake now (internal ticket VIN-4821). I'll attach the SOC2 summary and prefill the common questionnaire answers (data retention = 90 days default; subprocessor list attached; encryption = AES-256 at rest/TLS 1.3 in transit). Rafael, please confirm the subprocessor CSV is the latest.

I'll follow up with Sally's portal admin and request expedited review — aim to have a portal status update to Rajiv by tomorrow EOB PT. If procurement still needs more time, let's hold on rescheduling the hands-on demo until we have explicit portal clearance; otherwise we can run the May 13 30-minute overview Rafael suggested.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@medsys.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sally Cho <sally.cho@medsys.co>, Procurement Team <procurement@medsys.co>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirming May 19 demo — vendor portal + NDA prerequisites

Monica / team —

Thanks for the SOC2 summary and for opening VIN-4821. Procurement confirms they can only clear demo access after the questionnaire is complete and validated by our security team. Our CISO will be traveling May 23-27 and unavailable for final sign-off until the first week of June. Could we please move the hands-on demo to the week of June 1? Prefer Tue Jun 1 or Thu Jun 3 — both work for our security and product folks.

We would welcome Rafael's 30-minute overview on Thu May 13 at 11:00am PT in the interim — that will help our PMs and engineers get up to speed without requiring portal clearance. Please send the meeting invite and dial-in details.

Procurement also shared a short checklist link for vendors: https://vendorportal.medsys.co/requests/VP-7891 — it lists the exact fields they want completed.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Rajiv
VP, Eng — Medsys Health
